items.question: What is the biggest benefit of hiring a Master Elite contractor?

children.text: Access to Golden Pledge on a qualifying roof, together with a contractor who meets GAF’s certification and renewal requirements. It gives you a broader choice of manufacturer protection when you replace your roof.

items.question: Is Golden Pledge automatically included with every Roof King roof?

children.text: No. The roof must qualify, and the enhanced warranty must be selected and registered. Ask which warranty is included in your proposal.

items.question: How is GAF-backed workmanship protection different from a product warranty?

children.text: Product coverage concerns manufacturing defects. Misapplication coverage concerns covered installation errors. Golden Pledge includes both, with the covered products, flashings, remedies and conditions defined in its written terms.

items.question: Does lifetime coverage mean the roof never needs replacing?

children.text: No. Lifetime is a defined warranty term tied to eligible ownership and property types; it is not a prediction of roof life or a promise against all damage.

items.question: Can I choose my own shingle color and style?

children.text: Yes. Explore GAF products, then discuss availability and the warranty choices for your selected shingles and accessories with our team.

sections.title: Why Golden Pledge® Makes a Difference

children.text: A product warranty addresses manufacturing defects. Golden Pledge adds protection for covered installation errors, so the warranty you choose can address both the materials and how they were installed.
Read GAF’s Golden Pledge warranty terms
Qualifying shingles and accessories receive enhanced manufacturing-defect protection. Necessary tear-off and disposal are included for covered claims under the warranty terms.
For an approved misapplication claim, GAF can arrange repairs or provide the remedy described in the warranty. Covered flashings include locations such as chimneys, valleys and plumbing vents.

children.text: Your roofer is responsible for the details you will not see once the shingles are on. Certification gives you another way to evaluate the company doing that work.
GAF contractor program requirements

GAF’s published program requirements include liability and workers’ compensation insurance, with licensing where required. Experience and customer reviews are also factors in its certification process.
Master Elite renewal includes annual learning credits. That keeps education about roofing products and installation part of maintaining the designation.

The Benefits of Hiring a GAF Master Elite® Contractor
A new roof is a major investment. Our certification gives you more ways to protect it, with warranty choices tied to the GAF roof you select.
See Roof King’s Master Elite certification at GAF
Golden Pledge® Access
Only a GAF Master Elite contractor can offer Golden Pledge on an eligible roof. That gives you an enhanced warranty choice beyond what a non-certified installer can offer.
50-Year Defect Protection Period

Eligible Golden Pledge systems receive a 50-year Smart Choice® period for manufacturing defects. Non-prorated protection means covered remedies are not reduced for the age of the roof during that period.
GAF-Backed Workmanship Coverage
Golden Pledge also covers qualifying installation errors, including covered flashings. You can choose manufacturer-backed installation protection alongside Roof King’s separate workmanship coverage.
Qualifications You Can Verify

GAF’s program requires insurance and licensing where required, considers experience and reviews, and sets annual learning requirements for Master Elite renewal. You have a current manufacturer listing to check before hiring.
Why Golden Pledge® Makes a Difference

System Plus®
Enhanced manufacturing-defect protection for a qualifying roof system. Installation-error coverage is not included.
Silver Pledge™
Adds manufacturer-backed coverage for qualifying installation errors. Available through GAF Certified Plus™ and Master Elite contractors.
Golden Pledge®

Your GAF Roof Estimate and Warranty

Roof King’s published five-year workmanship coverage is separate from GAF’s warranty. Your proposal should explain both and tell you who to contact for help.

Does lifetime coverage mean the roof never needs replacing?
No. Lifetime is a defined warranty term tied to eligible ownership and property types; it is not a prediction of roof life or a promise against all damage.

Yes. Explore GAF products, then discuss availability and the warranty choices for your selected shingles and accessories with our team.
